# Capoeira
Capoeira, the Syndicate's dance of war originating in Brazil, is a [textlink="martial art" link="MartialArts"] that disguises violence as beauty. Swift attacks link into flowing combos, each move faster and harder than the last one, fueled by relentless momentum.
## Special abilities
### Capoeira Stance
You never stop moving while performing the ginga. This makes you very mobile while fighting.
Through swift motion, Capoeira masters channel speed into energy, with combos being more deadly the faster they are. Halt their flow, and their strength will vanish. Their combos, powered by movement, falter when they are prone.
### Capoeira Momentum
Through the flowing, relentless motion of Capoeira, each successful combo restores the user's stamina. Every connected strike fuels their endurance, allowing them to fight longer, faster, and harder without pause.
The heavier the combo, the more it restores. This does not scale with speed.
### Capoeira Tempo
Hit or miss, it's just part of the dance! And the best part is about to start!
A missed bare-handed attack sharpens the next, reducing its recovery and increasing the damage.
## Combo attacks
### Push Kick
Pushes the target back, breaking through their defenses temporarily making them vulnerable to melee attacks.
### Circle Kick
Deals Blunt damage and also slows down the opponent significantly.
### Sweep Kick
Knocks down and deals Blunt and Stamina damage. Temporarily increases the user's attack speed. Cannot be performed if the user is moving too slow.
### Spin Kick
Deals a lot of damage, knocks the opponent down and breaks any grab on them. Also makes the user flip, and increases their attack speed. Only works on standing opponents. Cannot be performed if the user is moving too slow.
### Kick Up
Needs to be targeted at the user themselves. Can be performed while prone. Removes knock down status effect and forces the user to stand up instantly.
